notes: iPads and phones in the office: an admin can turn it on in Settings → About. Staff then open Diastema on an iPad or phone on the office Wi-Fi at your office's own address (shown there, with a QR code to scan), with a real certificate that this server holds and renews on its own. Everyone still signs in with their PIN. Computers in the office keep using Diastema exactly as before, even when the internet is down.
